verdict.rationale: Docs confirm the mobile app supports tabs, command palette, and full plugin support (docs-34) plus a customizable editing toolar (docs-14/25), indicating feature parity with desktop rather than a stripped companion, and the same Markdown vault format underlies both platforms enabling linking (docs-18, docs-20). However, community evidence surfaces a concrete reliability issue specific to the Android app (files not saved to storage until note unloads, causing lost content on sync) and general dissatisfaction with mobile UX/Electron design relative to native apps, undercutting a fully polished power-user experience. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of mobile search functionality, mobile graph view parity, and independent confirmation the Android save bug has been resolved.
